# KORTEX

> KORTEX is a GEO, SEO and content creation studio based in Fès, Morocco, serving clients worldwide. A client provides one source (a blog post, YouTube video, podcast episode or webinar) and KORTEX turns it into 30+ assets built to be cited by AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews and Claude, and ranked by search engines. Expertise is extracted from the client's own content, never invented, and a person reviews everything before publication.

Plans: GHOST from 2,500 EUR per month, SWARM 5,500 EUR per month, TITAN from 12,000 EUR per month. No setup fees, no commitment. Founder: Hamza Bentarhlia. Contact: contact@kortexlab.me

## Glossary
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://www.kortexlab.me/glossary/answer-engine-optimization/): Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) means shaping content so it is chosen as the direct answer by voice assistants, featured snippets and AI engines. How it relates to GEO.
- [Answer-first content](https://www.kortexlab.me/glossary/answer-first-content/): Answer-first content opens each page or section with a direct, complete answer before adding detail. Why AI engines quote it more easily.
- [Citation rate](https://www.kortexlab.me/glossary/citation-rate/): Citation rate is the share of tracked questions for which an AI engine names or links your brand in its answer. How it is measured and why it varies.
- [Entity](https://www.kortexlab.me/glossary/entity/): An entity is a person, company, product, place or concept that a machine can identify without ambiguity. Why consistent entities help AI engines cite you.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.kortexlab.me/glossary/generative-engine-optimization/): Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of structuring content so AI answer engines can understand it, quote it and name you as the source. Definition and examples.
- [Google AI Overviews](https://www.kortexlab.me/glossary/ai-overviews/): Google AI Overviews are AI-written summaries shown at the top of some Google results, with links to the sources used. How they affect visibility.
- [llms.txt](https://www.kortexlab.me/glossary/llms-txt/): llms.txt is a proposed plain-text file at the root of a website that gives language models a short description of the site and links to its most useful pages.
- [Schema markup](https://www.kortexlab.me/glossary/schema-markup/): Schema markup is structured data added to a web page that tells machines what the content is: an article, a product, an FAQ, an organization. Why it helps AI and search engines.
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://www.kortexlab.me/glossary/search-engine-optimization/): Search Engine Optimization (SEO) is the work of making web pages easy for search engines to crawl, understand and rank. Why it still matters when AI engines answer questions.
- [Topical authority](https://www.kortexlab.me/glossary/topical-authority/): Topical authority is the degree to which search and AI engines see a site as a reliable source on a subject, built by covering it deeply and consistently.

## Comparisons
- [KORTEX vs a freelance writer](https://www.kortexlab.me/compare/kortex-vs-freelance-writer/): A good freelance writer delivers well-written articles. KORTEX delivers a structured month of content across formats, built from your expertise and shaped for AI citation. Which fits you, and when not to choose KORTEX.
- [KORTEX vs an SEO agency](https://www.kortexlab.me/compare/kortex-vs-seo-agency/): An SEO agency improves rankings. KORTEX builds content from your expertise and structures it to be cited in AI answers, with SEO included. When each one fits, and when not to choose KORTEX.
- [KORTEX vs doing it yourself with ChatGPT](https://www.kortexlab.me/compare/kortex-vs-chatgpt/): You can draft content with ChatGPT for a few euros a month. What it does not do on its own: extract your expertise, check facts, keep 30 formats consistent and track citations. An honest comparison.
